fun_facts: Simi Fehoko’s hometown is Sandy, Utah.
As a redshirt freshman, Simi Fehoko averaged 23.6 yards per catch, gaining 566 yards on 24 receptions—a school record for that average.
In his final Stanford game, Simi Fehoko caught 16 passes for 230 yards and three touchdowns. The catches set a school record, and the yardage was the third-highest total in program history.
Simi Fehoko was named first-team All-Pac-12 by The Associated Press in 2020 after catching 37 passes for 584 yards and three touchdowns in six games.
Simi Fehoko finished his Stanford career with 62 catches, 1,146 receiving yards, and nine touchdowns in 22 games.

* AP

Dec 28, 2020, 12:41 PM ET

STANFORD, Calif. -- Stanford wide receiver [Simi Fehoko](https://www.espn.com/college-football/player/_/id/4360739/simi-fehoko) is skipping his senior season to enter the NFL draft.

Fehoko finished his Stanford career with 62 receptions for 1,146 yards and nine touchdowns in 22 games. He was named a first-team All-Pac-12 player this season by The Associated Press after catching 37 passes for 584 yards and three TDs in six games.

Fehoko caught a school-record 16 passes for 230 yards and three touchdowns in his final game when the Cardinal beat UCLA in double overtime at the Rose Bowl.
